name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: a usage band, a tamagotchi-style aquarium, a narrator pane and a platformer that plays while Claude works.

plugins.name: pillbar
plugins.description: Capsule band above the prompt: 5-hour and weekly quota, context window, CPU, memory and disk

plugins.name: clawd-run
plugins.description: While Claude works on a long turn, Clawd plays a side-scrolling platformer above the prompt

plugins.name: plain-narrator
plugins.description: A narrator pane that explains in plain language what Claude is doing, with a side chat you can ask using the model you pick

plugins.name: token-tank
plugins.description: A pixel-art aquarium in a pane: Claude's work feeds the fish, the fish spit coins, you collect them and grow the tank.
